sections.title: Opening a sentence with your view
sections.content: szerintem ("in my opinion, I think") opens a sentence with your own view. It's built from szerint ("according to") plus a possessive suffix, so it follows the same pattern you already know: szerintem ("according to me"), szerinted ("according to you"), szerinte ("according to him/her").

items.english: In my opinion, this is a good book.
Do you think this story is interesting?

sections.content: szerintem sits comfortably right at the start of a sentence — exactly where English puts "I think..." — making it one of the easiest, most natural ways to open an opinion in Hungarian.
